v.title: Yamal’s Late Call Sparks Spain’s ‘Privilege’ Debate
v.excerpt: Spain denies Lamine Yamal got ‘special privileges’ after late squad call‑up – coach insists it was a logistical hiccup.
v.body:
## Quick take
Luis de la Fuente has flat‑out denied that Lamine Yamal was granted special treatment after joining the Spain squad later than his teammates. The coach insists the delay was a logistical hiccup, not a deliberate favour.

## What happened
During the build‑up to the Euro 2024 qualifiers, Spain’s squad was announced with 26 players, but Yamal’s name appeared only after the initial release. The Spanish Football Federation confirmed the player was registered late due to travel arrangements, but fans quickly speculated that the 18‑year‑old was being given a “special pass” to impress.

De la Fuente addressed the rumours in a post‑press conference, calling the claims “baseless” and stressing that all squad members were treated equally. He added that Yamal’s inclusion was a strategic decision, not a privilege, and that the delay had no impact on training or match readiness.

## Why it matters
- **Barcelona’s talent pipeline**: Yamal is a rising star in the Barca academy, and his national team exposure could accelerate his progression. If Spain’s selection process is perceived as unfair, it might influence how clubs like Barcelona scout and promote young talent.
- **Spain’s image on the global stage**: The federation’s handling of squad announcements reflects on its professionalism. A perceived bias could damage Spain’s reputation, especially as they aim to cement their status after Euro 2020.
- **Yamal’s confidence and development**: Being singled out for a “special privilege” narrative could pressure the player. A clear statement from de la Fuente may reassure him that merit, not politics, drives his selection, which is vital for his growth.

## What's next
Watch the next Spain friendly against France on 15 October. Yamal will be in the starting XI, and the match will be a litmus test for how the coach manages squad cohesion after the controversy. Barcelona fans should note how Yamal’s performance could influence his future role at the club, especially as Barça prepares for a tough La Liga season. The spotlight will be on whether de la Fuente’s dismissal of the privilege claim holds up under scrutiny or if it sparks deeper scrutiny into Spain’s selection policies.
